outcome: Correlation between duration of recovery and hyperbilirubinemia, PT, plasma fibrinogen levels, and platelet counts
Predictive value of elevated leukocytes, hypoglycemia, hepatic aminotransferase and uric acid levels for AFLP prognosis
cohort: 43 patients with acute fatty liver of pregnancy (AFLP) at a tertiary referral center over 5 years
finding: Prenatal serum bilirubin, PT, plasma fibrinogen levels and platelet counts are predictors of postpartum recovery in women with AFLP, while elevated leukocytes, hypoglycemia, hepatic aminotransferase and uric acid levels do not predict prognosis.
